title: Use mimalloc 0.1.48 (v3) as Engram's global allocator on every platform
outcome: Use mimalloc 0.1.48 (v3) as Engram's global allocator on every platform
acceptance: Cargo.toml declares exactly `mimalloc = { version = "0.1.48", features = ["v3"] }` and the engram binaries set it as #[global_allocator]; Cargo.lock is updated by cargo, not by hand.

The mimalloc-only change is included in the nearest integrating Windows batch's exact-input full gate and required independent Codex and Claude review; no separate mimalloc test round is required, per Greg #1195.

completion.summary: Completed: the mimalloc 0.1.48 v3 allocator change is present in landed master commit 6b48088823ac80b492c1e683217ccfdda7c721e8. Fresh independent acceptance evaluation 6d4c9d92bf9640ce8822251d0faaa039 passed both criteria. Reused the existing Windows FULL and independent review evidence for the integrating batch; no new test run was required or performed.
